an4.37:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo parihānāya nibbānass' eva santike.
an4.37:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti indriyesu guttadvāro hoti bhojane mattaññū hoti jāgariyam anuyutto hoti. 2.
an4.37:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti?
an4.37:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an4.37:2.3: Evaṃ kho bikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti. 3.
an4.37:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
an4.37:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
an4.37:3.3: yatvādhikaraṇaṃ enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati,
an4.37:3.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
an4.37:3.9: yatvādhikaraṇaṃ enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāsseyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an4.37:3.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti. 4.
an4.37:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti?
an4.37:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti,
an4.37:4.3: n' eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya: iti purāṇañ ca vedanañ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu-vihāro cāti.
an4.37:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti. 5
an4.37:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti?
an4.37:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti,
an4.37:5.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti,
an4.37:5.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā,
an4.37:5.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an4.37:5.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
an4.37:5.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo parihānāya nibbānass' eva santike ti. 6.
